\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{اقتصاد} (eqtesâd)}{اقتصاد (eqtesâd)}]{\fa{اقتصاد} (eqtesâd) — the economy; economics}

\label{lesson:FA-C413-eqtesad}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for the stock exchange, then the Persian for bankrupt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{اقتصاد}}
\textbf{\fa{اقتصاد}} (\emph{eqtesâd}) — \textquotedblleft{}the economy; economics\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{اقتصاد} \fa{کشور} \fa{در} \fa{حال} \fa{رشد} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{eqtesâd-e keshvar dar hâl-e roshd ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The country's economy is growing.
\end{quote}

\emph{Eqtesâdi} — economic.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{اقتصاد}} was borrowed from Arabic \emph{iqtiṣād} \textquotedblleft{}economy; economics\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{eqtesâd}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{eqtesâd}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{eqtesâd}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for the stock exchange, then the Persian for bankrupt, then say \emph{eqtesâd} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{تورم} (tavarrom)}{تورم (tavarrom)}]{\fa{تورم} (tavarrom) — inflation}

\label{lesson:FA-C413-tavarrom}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for bankrupt, then the Persian for the economy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{تورم}}
\textbf{\fa{تورم}} (\emph{tavarrom}) — \textquotedblleft{}inflation\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{تورم} \fa{امسال} \fa{بیشتر} \fa{از} \fa{پارسال} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{tavarrom emsâl bishtar az pârsâl ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Inflation this year is higher than last year.
\end{quote}

Literally swelling, and also a medical word.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{تورم}} comes from Arabic \emph{tawarrum} \textquotedblleft{}swelling\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB): inflation is prices swelling.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tavarrom}, once more

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for bankrupt, then the Persian for the economy, then say \emph{tavarrom} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{گرانی} (gerâni)}{گرانی (gerâni)}]{\fa{گرانی} (gerâni) — high prices, the cost of living}

\label{lesson:FA-C413-gerani}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for the economy, then the Persian for inflation.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{گرانی}}
\textbf{\fa{گرانی}} (\emph{gerâni}) — \textquotedblleft{}high prices, the cost of living\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{مردم} \fa{از} \fa{گرانی} \fa{شکایت} \fa{میکنند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mardom az gerâni shekâyat mikonand.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
People complain about high prices.
\end{quote}

\emph{Gerân} \textquotedblleft{}expensive\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-i}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{گرانی}} is native Persian, built from \emph{gerân} \textquotedblleft{}heavy, expensive\textquotedblright{}, which EtymDB traces to Middle Persian \emph{grān}, with the noun suffix \emph{-i}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for the economy, then the Persian for inflation, then say \emph{gerâni} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{یارانه} (yârâne)}{یارانه (yârâne)}]{\fa{یارانه} (yârâne) — a subsidy}

\label{lesson:FA-C413-yarane}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for inflation, then the Persian for high prices.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{یارانه}}
\textbf{\fa{یارانه}} (\emph{yârâne}) — \textquotedblleft{}a subsidy\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{دولت} \fa{به} \fa{خانواده} \fa{ها} \fa{یارانه} \fa{میدهد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{dowlat be khânevâde hâ yârâne midahad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The government gives families a subsidy.
\end{quote}

A modern coinage built on \emph{yâr} \textquotedblleft{}helper\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{یارانه}} is a modern Persian coinage, usually explained as built on \emph{yâr} \textquotedblleft{}friend, helper\textquotedblright{} with the suffix \emph{-âne}: money that helps.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{نرخ} (nerkh)}{نرخ (nerkh)}]{\fa{نرخ} (nerkh) — a rate}

\label{lesson:FA-C413-nerkh}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for high prices, then the Persian for a subsidy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{نرخ}}
\textbf{\fa{نرخ}} (\emph{nerkh}) — \textquotedblleft{}a rate\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{نرخ} \fa{بیکاری} \fa{کاهش} \fa{یافت}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nerkh-e bikâri kâhesh yâft.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The unemployment rate fell.
\end{quote}

\emph{Nerkh-e bahre} — the interest rate.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{نرخ}} \textquotedblleft{}rate, price\textquotedblright{} is a Persian word whose origin is not settled; EtymDB does not list it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
